breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the product of inertia even though the setup explicitly gives a nonzero I_yz and the unsymmetric bending formula depends on it.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the full unsymmetric bending formula that includes the product of inertia Iyz = 800000 mm^4 in all terms. It does not ignore Iyz or fall back to the simplified superposition approach (My·z/Iy + Mz·y/Iz) that the incomplete prompt incorrectly suggested. The denominator (Iy·Iz − Iyz^2) and both numerator terms (My·Iz − Mz·Iyz) and (Mz·Iy − My·Iyz) are all computed correctly using the nonzero product of inertia, matching the ground truth approach.
